_comment: Static Group measurement methodology rules. Seed definitions only - approvals, edits and versions are stored in data/knowledge/rule_state.json and recorded in the audit log. Status: CONFIRMED (explicit Static Group evidence / estimator approval), INFERRED (repeated pattern in historical projects, not confirmed), ASSUMED (temporary development rule), UNKNOWN (cannot be determined yet - candidates are shown, no value is chosen).

rules.title: Footing concrete
rules.description: How footing concrete is measured

options.outline_x_schedule_depth: Drawn footing outline x depth from the footing schedule

rules.evidence: Engine within -4 % (Al-Sulaiti) and -9 % (Al-Kawari) of the historical BOQ using this method; the residual is footings without schedule data.

rules.title: Ground / tie beam concrete
rules.description: How ground beams are measured

options.drawn_length_x_section: Drawn beam length (between supports) x width x depth (section/schedule)

rules.evidence: Al-Kawari engine +1.25 % vs historical BOQ. Al-Sulaiti cannot confirm (tie-beam depths missing in drawings as read).

rules.title: Blinding extent
rules.description: Which elements receive measured blinding

options.footings_and_ground_beams: Footing blinding + blinding under ground/tie beams (L x (W + 2 x projection) x t)

rules.evidence: Footing blinding alone is 27-29 % below both historical BOQs - a systematic gap that suggests more than footing blinding is measured.

rules.title: Blinding projection beyond concrete
rules.description: Projection of blinding each side of a ground beam (m)
rules.evidence: Footing blinding outlines on S-FP are drawn 100 mm outside the footing (all three projects); ground beams have no drawn blinding.

rules.title: Column & wall height
rules.description: Height used for columns and RC walls

options.floor_to_floor: Top of slab to top of slab above
options.to_slab_soffit: Top of slab to underside of slab above
options.schedule_height: Height from a column schedule / section

rules.evidence: Both historical BOQs are 18-23 % above the engine for either floor-to-floor or soffit height, so height alone does not explain the gap.

rules.title: Storey level per floor
rules.description: Which level tag represents a floor when several T.O.S values exist

options.most_frequent: Most frequent T.O.S tag on the framing plan

rules.evidence: Development rule. Levels vary within each floor (e.g. Al-Kawari GR: -0.65 ... +0.45).

rules.title: Beam depth
rules.description: Depth used for suspended beams

options.below_slab: Overall depth minus slab thickness (slab measured over beams)

rules.evidence: Al-Kawari: below-slab 69.0 m3, full depth 83.6 m3, BOQ 135.5 m3 - neither option closes the gap, so beam extent is also in question.

rules.title: Neck column height
rules.description: Height of neck columns below ground level

options.tof_to_gb_soffit: Top of footing to underside of ground beam
options.tof_to_sog_top: Top of footing to top of slab on grade

rules.evidence: Neck column sections are on S-FP; their tops are not dimensioned.

rules.title: Block wall height
rules.description: Height used for block work

options.floor_to_floor: Storey height (top of slab to top of slab)
options.to_slab_soffit: Top of slab to underside of slab

rules.evidence: Not stated in BOQ or drawings.

rules.title: Openings in block work
rules.description: Whether door/window openings are deducted from block work
rules.evidence: Not stated.

rules.title: Openings in plaster
rules.description: Whether openings are deducted from plaster
rules.evidence: Not stated.

rules.title: Internal plaster faces
rules.description: Which wall faces receive internal plaster

options.internal_both_plus_external_inner: Both faces of internal walls + inner face of external walls
options.internal_both_only: Both faces of internal walls only

rules.evidence: Al-Kawari internal plaster 4,095 m2 vs internal block 1,169 m2 and external block 2,087 m2 - consistent with the first option before deductions; not confirmed.

rules.title: Lintel bearing
rules.description: Lintel length beyond each side of an opening (m)
rules.evidence: Lintels are one BOQ line in lm; 'BA Lintels' lines on framing plans are an alternative source.

rules.title: Excavation working space
rules.description: Working space added around foundations (m each side)
rules.evidence: Not stated.

rules.title: Natural ground level
rules.description: Existing ground level from which excavation is measured (m, project datum)
rules.evidence: No soil report / survey in the drawing sets (S-FP note for Ramzi).

rules.title: Removal of excavated material
rules.description: Removal quantity equals bulk excavation
rules.evidence: Identical values in both historical BOQs (Al-Kawari 2,131.23 = 2,131.23; Al-Sulaiti 2,124.98 = 2,124.98; boundary walls likewise).

rules.title: Backfill
rules.description: How backfill is derived

options.excavation_minus_buried: Excavation minus buried concrete and blinding

rules.evidence: Historical difference excavation - backfill: Al-Kawari 167.4 m3, Al-Sulaiti 240.6 m3.

rules.title: Substructure waterproofing surfaces
rules.description: Which faces of footings / ground beams / neck columns are measured

options.sides_and_tops: Vertical = all sides; horizontal = tops of footings and ground beams

rules.evidence: BOQ wording: 'Villa & Annex (Footings + Ground beam + Neck column)', horizontal and vertical lines.

rules.title: Electrical manhole count
rules.description: Source for electrical manhole numbers

options.power_manhole_labels: Count of 'POWER MANHOLE' labels on E-050

rules.evidence: Al-Sulaiti: 6 labels = BOQ 6. Al-Kawari: 8 labels vs BOQ 3 - contradicts; labels may annotate shared manholes.

rules.title: Slab on grade extent
rules.description: Which ground-floor zones are measured as SOG

options.tagged_sog_zones: Zones tagged S.O.G. on the ground framing plan

rules.evidence: Al-Kawari tagged ground zones give 176 m3 vs BOQ 101 m3.

rules.title: Tank geometry
rules.description: Where tank sizes come from

options.user_input: Estimator enters internal L x W x H and thicknesses

rules.evidence: Historical BOQ headings state tank sizes; drawings: A-007 Tanks Enlargement / A-009 Underground Tanks Details.

rules.title: Boundary wall geometry
rules.description: Length and typical section of the boundary wall

options.site_plan_and_typical_section: Plot boundary length from site plan x typical section
options.user_input: Estimator enters length, height and section

rules.evidence: Historical BOQ headings: 166.5 m x 3.15 m (Al-Kawari), 167.60 m x 3.0 m (Al-Sulaiti).
